idea-plugin.name: Claude Chappe
idea-plugin.description:
Colours each project window by the state of the Claude Code sessions running in its terminals, so a stack of open windows tells you at a glance which one needs you.

  • Green — at least one session is processing.
  • Red — a session is waiting for a decision, or has finished its turn.
  • Untouched — nothing running.

The window gets a coloured border and, optionally, a tinted status bar — the part that usually stays visible when windows overlap. A Cascade Project Windows action in the Window menu stacks every open project on one screen and puts the most urgent one in front.

State comes from Claude Code hooks, not from scraping terminal output. The hook script and its installer ship with the plugin repository.

Named after Claude Chappe, who built the optical telegraph in 1792: status carried over distance by nothing but what you can see from far away.

action.description: Stack all open project windows on one screen, most urgent in front
